docs: ## Installation **Command** ```install npx shadcn@latest add @cadence/textarea ``` Usage, the examples and the top preview also use [Label](/components/label). Install it when copying those compositions: ```install npx shadcn@latest add @cadence/label ``` The Controlled value and character count example also renders [Button](/components/button) for its external action: ```install npx shadcn@latest add @cadence/button ``` **Manual** Use React 19, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS v4 with the shadcn semantic colour tokens. Follow the [manual setup guide](https://cadence.dev/docs/installation#manual-installation) for the base CSS and aliases; copying files does not require the shadcn CLI. 1. Install the component's complete recursive npm dependencies (versions are preserved). Example-only packages are listed separately below when needed. ```package-manager npm install clsx tailwind-merge ``` 2. Copy the following registry dependencies in the listed dependency order. Each JSON link exposes every file's full `content` and `target`; copy all files, including multi-file helpers. - [@cadence/cadence-utils](https://cadence.dev/r/cadence-utils.json) — direct registry dependency. 3. Place every file at its target below. `@components` means your components directory, for example `src/components`; keep the remaining `cadence/` tree and relative imports intact. Each source block on the website copies the entire file, including folded lines. | Item | Target file | Full source | | --- | --- | --- | | cadence-utils | `@components/cadence/lib/cn.ts` | [JSON files[].content](https://cadence.dev/r/cadence-utils.json) | | textarea | `@components/cadence/textarea/index.tsx` | [JSON files[].content](https://cadence.dev/r/textarea.json) | [Source files: cadence-utils](https://cadence.dev/r/cadence-utils.json) [Source files: textarea](https://cadence.dev/r/textarea.json) 4. Apply the required CSS/configuration below, then follow [Usage](#usage) for the component imports and composition. No additional item-specific CSS configuration is required beyond the base theme. Textarea needs only the two files and packages listed above; no motion runtime, provider or additional item-specific CSS is required. Keep `textarea/index.tsx` and `lib/cn.ts` at the listed relative paths so the shared `cn` import resolves. Give the textarea an accessible name with a label and matching `htmlFor` / `id` as shown in Usage. Content-driven growth uses CSS `field-sizing: content` through Tailwind's `field-sizing-content` utility; there is no JavaScript auto-grow fallback. For the labelled compositions, follow [Label's installation](/components/label#installation) and copy its component file alongside Textarea; the shared `lib/cn.ts` and its packages are already included above. For the Controlled example's action, follow [Button's installation](/components/button#installation), including its dependencies and motion setup. Label and Button are example dependencies, not dependencies of Textarea. Button is rendered only in Controlled; the unused `Button` and `useState` imports in the other example snippets can be omitted. React's `useId` and `useState` need no additional package beyond the React setup above. ## Usage ```tsx import { Label } from "@/components/cadence/label"; import { Textarea } from "@/components/cadence/textarea"; export function Comment() { return (
